scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: Ignored customer fury and overdraft stress at [03:20] when three post-cancellation direct debits were collected.

scorecard.name: Paraphrasing
scorecard.coaching: Failed to paraphrase customer's dispute, merely echoing that cancellation was submitted in August.

scorecard.name: Took ownership of the problem
scorecard.coaching: Deflected responsibility at [04:45] by telling customer to raise an indemnity claim with Barclays rather than resolving refund directly.

scorecard.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
scorecard.coaching: Spoke rudely at [04:10] by stating customer should have checked his bank statements rather than taking accountability.

scorecard.name: Probing
scorecard.coaching: Failed to ask probing questions regarding return tracking receipts or cancellation email records.

grader.scenario: Direct debit billed three months after cancelling contract and returning equipment
grader.notes: Agent exhibited serious customer service failures including blaming the customer for not checking his bank statements, deflecting responsibility to the customer's bank, and failing to show empathy, though eventual supervisor refund authorization resolved the monetary dispute.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent opened with 'Thank you for calling S-Net billing customer services' at [00:00] and closed with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' in final lines.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Holds announced with bear with me and thanked upon return without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified full postal address and security PIN within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent addressed customer as Declan throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Customer expressed severe frustration over £162 taken and overdraft charges; agent offered no acknowledgment or apology.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent never restated the dispute in his own words.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent maintained accurate details and did not ask for previously supplied information again.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: [04:45] Agent: 'Under banking rules, if you want immediate reimbursement, you need to contact Barclays directly to raise a direct debit indemnity claim rather than expecting customer services to issue manual refunds.'

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: [04:10] Agent: 'Well if you had actually checked your monthly bank statements in September, you would have noticed the first collection and contacted us before three cycles ran.'

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent did not probe into warehouse return logs or prior cancellation notes.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Customer confirmed receipt of refund email confirmation for £162 and accepted mandate cancellation.
